description: A crude bionic capacitor assembled from salvaged batteries, scrap copper wiring, and improvised voltage regulators packed into a dented metal casing. Can be installed to increase bionic power capacity by 50 kJ.
A set of salvaged sheet metal plates ready for crude subdermal implantation. Installs as protective plating for the torso, offering modest physical protection at the cost of reduced flexibility.

A bundle of salvaged coil springs and braided steel cables designed for crude muscle augmentation. Can be installed to provide a +1 strength bonus, though the bulky mechanisms are far less elegant than professional myomer fibers.
